evaluation.test_separation: New fixed demand/SUMO seed realizations, disjoint from fit/stop/calibrate; same pinned timetable and generated route corridors.
evaluation.comparison: Three training seeds, three paired generated demand days; retain every branch/day/seed and compare all-seed means.
evaluation.completion: Report completion rate and departed/completed counts alongside cost.
evaluation.interpretation: Bounded pilot on one target city; no population-level CI or city removal.

code_boundary: Existing CFCMT frozen runtime, executor and assets; no mutable Thesis imports or writes.
name: cfcmt-bus-target-adapted-eval-v1
checkpoint_rule: All three existing training/adapt/target/seedN/adapted.pt actors; stored counter 5000 and historical 50000 target initialization + 5000 target adaptation = 55000. No fitting, seed or checkpoint selection.
export_rule: Read target_pool.h5 config attributes only; construct frozen learner and load existing network parameters with reset_columns=False. Export deployment actor and use the real v7 deployment loader to compare every actor tensor to the stored adapted actor. No replay construction, optimizer/update calls or ModelContinuation construction.
reference_policy: Primary matched phase reference: fixed full-source adapted actors at 55000 historical updates, same seed/case. Reuse the original strong rule. Require paired seeds, horizon, simulator version, line_ids, departed passenger counts and zero ledger error.
data_boundary: Local initialization and adaptation both use the original target fit 12288, target union 16384. No replay, source data or world-model loading during export. Only target_pool.h5 configuration attributes are read. No new training simulator events.
interpretation: Read-only matched initialization-route diagnostic on three training seeds and three previously analyzed generated target demand days. Neither compared actor used model TD or confidence-weighted continuation at this stage. No prospective test, cross-city population or physical sim-to-real claim. No mutable Thesis access.
next_decision: Report all-seed and each-seed costs, all nine paired cases, wait/ride, completion and executed holding. Determine whether the fixed source-initialization route improves the adapted actor over the matched local route; do not retune, continue training, change guards or remove seeds.
budget_boundary: Equal historical updates, CPU, IQL configuration, original target-fit unique rows and adaptation stage. Local has 55000 target updates; cross-city has 50000 source + 5000 target updates and retains its original transfer reset rules. This compares the fixed initialization routes, not equal target gradient exposure or equal wall-clock cost.
